route_results.reason: Campaign163 already freezes customer and supplier dependency and concentration, while Campaign210 and multiple sector lifecycle frontiers freeze invoice, collection and billing execution. Replacing annual disclosure or operator records with tax invoices observes the same counterparty demand, supply and concentration state through another source. No lawful complete issuer-to-taxpayer-to-counterparty point-in-time invoice archive is admitted either.

Branch and subsidiary formation, scope change, suspension and dissolution are economically distinct from acquisition consideration or a static company profile. However, no admitted archive binds listed issuer, historical parent, legal entity, branch, unified identifier, registration authority, event, effective date, first-public date, correction, cancellation and complete 2019-2023 market denominator. The available stock_company profile is current latest-state data and cannot be backcast.

Campaign173 already freezes tax qualification, credit, authority audit, assessment, dispute, penalty and compliance states and the complete source-admission requirements. Selecting public tax-credit grades, arrears or enforcement events is a field and authority subset of that terminal mechanism.

Campaign185 c185_01 already freezes land acquisition, title rights, zoning, mortgage or other encumbrance, withdrawal, forfeiture and disposal state. Using a land registry instead of issuer project records would be a prohibited source substitution and the historical parcel-holder contract remains unadmitted.

Campaign165 governs emissions, energy, environmental investment and compliance state, while Campaign179 explicitly separates environmental permits inside statutory operating-right lifecycles. Combining permit validity with emissions or compliance events does not create a new mechanism and no complete historical facility-permit-revision archive is admitted.

Campaign221 already freezes report, certificate, accreditation-scope, amendment, suspension, withdrawal, revocation and expiry lifecycles and rejects current certificate registries as historical evidence. Product-versus-provider role or certification subset selection is a prohibited role and cohort variant.

Aggregate insured headcount or contribution activity re-expresses workforce scale, continuity and labor-cost compliance already bounded by Campaign164, with payroll-levy enforcement inside Campaign173. A government contribution registry would be a source and field variant, and no lawful privacy-safe full-market 2019-2023 employer history is admitted.

decision.reason: No frozen route simultaneously survives mechanism independence and point-in-time source-contract readiness. The priority selection rule therefore stops Campaign274 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign275 may freeze a new finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign274 route through a sibling provider, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold, direction or incomplete source.
